heading_stack: Other due diligence requirements that help to mitigate risks
payload.block_text: Organizations need to address risks from employees who might commit financial crimes or collaborate with criminals. A robust employee due diligence program, also known as a know your employee (KYE) program, lowers those risks. A know your vendor (KYV) program helps assess the risk of third-party vendors. Vendors might offer items of value to influence the actions of your employees, which leads to bribery and corruption risks.

payload.block_text: Background checks are necessary for all new employees in accordance with local employment laws and data protection laws. This might include contacting former employers, conducting credit checks, sanctions and PEP screening, and adverse media checks.
